decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (02-01, 20-01, 20-02, Location Plan received 19/10/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the occupation of the building hereby approved on the site the details of cycle parking facilities shall be submitted and approved and the details as approved shall be installed and retained during the lifetime of this development.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for business (B1) purposes and non-residential education and training (D1) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times:

8:00am-8:00pm Monday to Saturday.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the premises shall only be used for business purposes (B1) and non-residential education and training purposes, excluding infant primary or secondary schools, and shall not be used for any other purpose within Use Class D1 without further approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Change of Use from office (B1) to dual use Office (B1) and Educational (D1) for a further period of 10 years
